title: GameStateSnapshot
description: Cumulative game state carried into a half-inning (spec §7). Cache only — always reproducible by folding from genesis. Per-half state (count, outs, bases) is deliberately excluded: it always resets to empty at a half-inning boundary, so caching it would be redundant.

nextBatterIndexByTeam.description: teamId -> index into that team's LineupSet.battingOrder for the next batter due

pitchCountByPitcher.description: pitcherId -> total pitches thrown so far this game

inferredPitchEffects.description: pitch event id -> count effect that a CountCorrection's back-inference resolved uniquely (spec §12.5). Cumulative across halves like the other fields; empty when no inference has occurred.
